description: The pension annual allowance once threshold income passes £200,000: whether it tapers, the reduced allowance, and how far contributions are over it. Use for 'how much can I pay into my pension on £280k'.

adjustedIncome.description: Threshold income plus every pension contribution made for them, the employer's included.

pensionContributions.description: Everything going into pensions for them this year. Defaults to 0.

thresholdIncome.description: Net income less their own pension contributions (HMRC's threshold income).

name: calculate_annual_allowance_taper
title: Annual allowance taper
